tagline: From Doc Watson's Deep Gap up the ridge toward Boone.
intro: US 421 has come a long way by now. It starts at Fort Fisher on the coast, crosses the whole state, and in the last five miles before Deep Gap climbs the steep escarpment on the eastern edge of the Blue Ridge.

The byway begins at Deep Gap, where the Blue Ridge Parkway crosses overhead on a bridge faced with native stone. From there the road ascends the ridge some eight and a half miles toward Boone, with Snake Mountain and Elk Knob in view and hardwood and mixed forest, horse and cattle farms along the way.

moments.title: Deep Gap
moments.text: Doc Watson was born here and lived here until 2012, and he got his nickname on the radio, when an announcer wanted something easier than Arthel and a fan shouted for Doc.

moments.title: Christmas tree farms
moments.text: Fraser fir Christmas tree farms show along the climb, in a county that is a leading national producer of the trees.

moments.title: South Fork New River
moments.text: The byway ends near the bridge over the South Fork of the New River, a northward-flowing river that some scientists believe only the Nile can beat for age.
